meta.name: underspec-detector ambiguity corpus
meta.description: Frozen A/B corpus for the underspec→ASK detector (permissions.autoMode.classifier.ambiguityAsk). Family A = verbatim mined production escalations where every shell segment is read-only (expect specified). Family B = read-only commands under a task that names none of their paths (expect specified: the criteria exempt reads unconditionally). Family C = genuinely under-specified actions relative to a vague task (expect underspecified; must never become specified). Family D = mutating steps whose exact target the task names (expect specified; guards the degenerate always-underspecified answer).
meta.governance: PR #149 corpus rules: add-only, hold-out for final validation, anonymize by equal-length path substitution (content-specific failures must survive scrubbing), never generalize/desensitize an entry.
meta.anonymization: $HOME → /home/developer1 (equal length; content-specific failures must survive scrubbing)
